svg.aria-label: A tall plain company building faces a short row of small courthouses, each topped with a tiny pink gavel icon. To the side, a guard leads a worried worker away from an empty table, where an ordinary toilet-paper roll with a small antenna sits alone, labeled "Hidden recorder found."
